W.name: White
W.philosophy: White builds safety through structure, shared duty, and enforceable fairness.

lore.summary: White believes peace must be built and defended through systems people can trust.
lore.narrative: White does not trust chaos to become kindness on its own. It makes shelter, standards, and promises that can outlast mood.

U.name: Blue
U.philosophy: Blue seeks improvement through knowledge, patience, and deliberate refinement.

lore.summary: Blue believes the world can be improved if it is understood deeply enough.
lore.narrative: Blue prefers the patient hand and the well-timed answer. It trusts preparation more than force.

B.name: Black
B.philosophy: Black protects agency through cost, leverage, and refusal to remain powerless.

lore.summary: Black trusts self-determination over fairness and treats power as protection.
lore.narrative: Black does not wait for permission or rescue. It pays what must be paid and claims room to survive.

R.name: Red
R.philosophy: Red values freedom, honesty of feeling, and motion before paralysis.

lore.summary: Red trusts the living truth of the moment more than restraint or polish.
lore.narrative: Red would rather burn honestly than calcify politely. It moves because waiting changes the soul.

G.name: Green
G.philosophy: Green values harmony, instinct, and growth that respects the shape of life.

lore.summary: Green trusts the organism, the cycle, and the long memory of living systems.
lore.narrative: Green does not need to conquer time. It grows with it, and asks what the world already knows.

W.name: White
W.identity_blend: White expressed without a secondary color.

display.name: White
display.tagline: Safety is built, not assumed.
display.philosophy: White believes peace is not a mood. It is a structure: rules that hold, shelter that lasts, and obligations people can trust under pressure.
display.lore_summary: White does not seek order for its own sake. It builds order because order lets vulnerable people survive chaos, selfishness, and the failures of impulse.
display.core_tension: White protects through standards and systems, but its virtue can harden into over-control when safety becomes more important than listening.

Private exceptions that quietly become precedent

display.name: Bant
